svg.title: Prior, likelihood and posterior on one axis
svg.desc: A broad Beta(2, 2) prior, a rescaled binomial likelihood peaking at 0.65, and a narrow posterior peaking between them at 0.6429.
svg.text: Prior times likelihood, normalized, is the posterior
Meridian seed lot: 26 of 40 seeds germinated
The posterior mean lands between 0.5 and 0.65, much closer to the data, because forty observations outweigh a prior worth four.
